answers.plain:
**🍪 Fall Bake Sale at Lincoln Elementary! 🍂**

**Friday, October 31 | 8:00–10:00 AM**

The Lincoln Elementary PTA is hosting our Fall Bake Sale, and we need your help to make it a success! We're asking families to donate homemade or store-bought baked goods. Cookies, cupcakes, muffins, brownies, breads, and seasonal treats are all welcome. Since it's Halloween, festive creations are encouraged!

**Allergen labels are required.** To keep every student safe, please label each item with:

- The name of the baked good
- A list of ingredients, or at least a clear note on any common allergens it contains or may contain (peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, wheat, soy, fish, shellfish, sesame)
- Whether it was made in a home where nuts or other allergens are present

Individually wrapped items or packages of clearly labeled portions are ideal. Items without labels can't be sold, so please don't skip this step.

**How to donate:** Please drop off your items at [drop-off location] on [day/time]. If you can't bake but would still like to help, we'd love your support by shopping the sale or volunteering at the table.

All proceeds benefit [what the funds support, e.g., classroom supplies, field trips, school events].

Questions? Contact [name] at [email/phone].

Thank you for helping make this a sweet morning for our Lincoln Elementary community!

*Your PTA Bake Sale Co-Chairs*

---

I left bracketed placeholders for the drop-off details, what the proceeds fund, and contact info. Send me those and I'll fill them in. I can also shorten it if the newsletter has a tight word limit.

## Newsletter Announcement

**🍂 Fall Bake Sale: Bakers Wanted! 🍁**

**Friday, Oct 31 | 8:00–10:00 AM | [Location, e.g., front entrance / cafeteria]**

Lincoln Elementary families, the PTA Fall Bake Sale is almost here, and we need your help to make it a success!

We're asking families to donate baked goods. Cookies, muffins, brownies, cupcakes, breads, and seasonal treats are all welcome. Whether you're an experienced baker or you're picking up something from the store, every contribution helps. Proceeds will support [what the funds go toward, e.g., classroom grants, field trips, the spring carnival].

**How to donate**
- **Drop off:** [day/time, e.g., Thursday after school or Friday 7:30–8:00 AM at the main office]
- **Sign up:** [link or QR code] so we know what to expect
- **Packaging:** Please bring items individually wrapped or in grab-and-go portions when possible.

**Allergen labels are required**
Many of our students have food allergies, so every item must have a label. Please include:
1. **Name of the item**
2. **A full ingredient list**, or at least a clear list of common allergens: **milk, eggs, wheat, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, fish, shellfish, and sesame**
3. **"Made in a home kitchen"** if applicable, and a note if your home has pets or if nuts are used regularly there

Please write "Nut-free" or "Gluten-free" only if you're confident the item was made without cross-contact. Items without a label can't be sold, and we'd hate to turn away your hard work.

**Want to do more?**
We also need volunteers to run the table, set up, and clean up. [Link to volunteer sign-up]

Thank you for supporting our school and the kids who benefit from it. We can't wait to see what you bake!

**Questions?** Contact [Your Name] or [Co-chair Name] at [email/phone].

*[Your Names], PTA Bake Sale Co-Chairs*

---

- **Timing:** Today is Monday, Oct 26, so the sign-up and drop-off window is short. I'd send the short version home right away and use the full version in the newsletter.
- **School policy:** Check whether Lincoln has rules on homemade food or a nut-free policy. If so, add a line such as "Lincoln is a nut-free school, so please no items containing peanuts or tree nuts." That changes the allergen section, so it's worth settling before this is published.
- **Reusable label:** I can draft a printable label template with checkboxes for each major allergen. It would make labeling easier for parents and more consistent for the sale table.
- **Halloween:** If the sale really is on Oct 31, a line like "Costumes welcome at the table!" would fit.

**Lincoln Elementary PTA Fall Bake Sale**
**Friday, October 31, 8:00–10:00 am**

Dear Lincoln families,

We're getting ready for our fall bake sale, and we'd love your help filling the tables. If you can, please donate something baked: cookies, muffins, brownies, banana bread, cupcakes, whatever you like to make. Every bit helps, and the kids will be thrilled.

Store-bought treats are just as welcome, and so are nut-free items. Many of our families need them, so those are especially appreciated.

**Drop-off:** [drop-off location and time] by [deadline]
**Sign up:** [sign-up link] (optional, but it helps us plan)

**Please label every item.** For everyone's safety, each donation needs a label that includes:

- **Name** of the item
- **Ingredients**
- **"Contains:"** line naming any of the major allergens: milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, wheat, soy, fish, shellfish, sesame. If none apply, please write "Contains: none of the major allergens."

Items without a label can't be sold, so please don't skip this step.

Thank you for all you do for our school. We can't wait to see what you bring, and we hope to see you at the sale!

Warmly,
The PTA Bake Sale Co-Chairs
Lincoln Elementary

---

Two notes: I added the "Contains: none…" wording and the "can't be sold" line as sensible defaults. Edit or remove them if that's not your policy. You'll also want to fill in the three bracketed blanks before sending.
